title: schoenoplectus × igaensis
intro: Schoenoplectus × igaensis, commonly known as Iga Cattail, is a hybrid plant species that is a cross between Schoenoplectus tabernaemontani and Schoenoplectus lacustris. It is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Iga Cattail include wound healing, reducing inflammation, and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
